guidance.claim: Sustain medium to long term EBITDA margins within 11% to 13%
guidance.quote: In line with our Project Spring roadmap, we remain confident of sustaining medium - to long -term EBITDA margins within our guided range of 11% to 13%.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.claim: Grow at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate
guidance.quote: Our objective continues to be growing at 1.5x to 2x of the industry growth rate while steadily enhancing profitability.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.claim: Working capital cycle to trend towards 45 to 50 days
guidance.quote: As these benefits gradually normalize, we expect the working capital cycle to trend towards our long-term operating range of 45 to 50 days.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.claim: Sustainable margins for EPC business to remain in high single-digit range
guidance.quote: Over the medium- to long-term, we continue to expect sustainable margins for the EPC business to remain in the high single -digit range, supported by disciplined project selection, efficient execution, and a healthy order pipeline.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.claim: Expect the EHV plant to commission in FY28
guidance.quote: So I would like to take this opportunity to sort of also let the investor community know that in terms of our EHV plant timelines, we are expecting the EHV plant to now commission somewhere in FY 2028, the next year, though, so FY28.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

guidance.claim: FMEG EBITDA margin to end up in the range of 8% to 10%
guidance.quote: So over the longer term, I believe we would end up in that kind of a range of 8% to 10% of the EBITDA margin.
guidance.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.quote: Consolidated revenue grew by 53% year-on-year, with all business segments contributing meaningfully to this growth momentum.
reported.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.quote: EBITDA increased by 39% year -on-year, while EBITDA margins expanded by more than 50 basis points sequentially to 14.4%, supported by a favourable business mix and continued focus on operational efficiencies.
reported.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.claim: Profit after tax reached a record high of INR 9,900 million
reported.quote: Profitability remained robust, with profit after tax reaching a record high of INR 9,900 million, representing a 43% year -over-year increase.
reported.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.claim: PAT margins stood at 10.0% for the quarter
reported.quote: PAT margins stood at 10 .0% for the quarter, reflecting healthy earnings growth and sustained margin resilience.
reported.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.claim: Net cash stood at INR 45.2 billion as of September 30, 2026
reported.quote: Net cash stood at INR 45.2 billion as of September 30th, 2026, compared to INR 29.4 billion a year ago.
reported.speaker: Aditya Nathany

reported.claim: Incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion during the first half
reported.quote: During the first half of the year, we incurred capital expenditures of INR 6.1 billion, reflecting our ongoing investments in capacity expansion, supply chain capabilities and future growth platforms.
reported.speaker: Aditya Nathany
